about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for hse-hsg33 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The italic subheading Emergency rescue procedures sits under Safe place of work on the roof in the source but is a sibling heading in the tree.
findings.evidence: tree: "PLANNING FOR SAFETY > Emergency rescue procedures"

findings.problem: The subheading 'Emergency rescue procedures' is read as body text at the end of paragraph 47, so paragraphs 48-51 sit directly under 'Safe place of work on the roof' without their own heading.
findings.evidence: source: heading "Emergency rescue procedures" / tree: "...provide the safest possible work area. Emergency rescue procedures"

findings.problem: The subheading Roof truss erection is appended to the last bullet of paragraph 132 and missing from the heading path of paragraphs 133 and 134.
findings.evidence: source: "Roof truss erection" (heading) / tree: "securing fall-protection systems. Roof truss erection"

findings.problem: The italic subheading 'Roof truss erection' sits under 'Slated and tiled (pitched) roofs' on the page but the tree makes it a sibling heading at the same level.
findings.evidence: source: "Roof truss erection" (italic subheading) / tree: "TYPES OF ROOF > Roof truss erection"

findings.problem: The next heading 'Handling roof cladding' is joined to the end of paragraph 246 as body text; it is not printed on this page.
findings.evidence: source: "...that you will need to take into consideration." / tree: "...that you will need to take into consideration. Handling roof cladding"

findings.problem: Paragraphs 278 to 283, with the heading 'Glues and solvents', are merged into paragraph 249 under 'Manual handling', so the glue and solvent rules sit under the wrong provision and the heading is read as body text.
findings.evidence: source: "282 Possible control measures include: brush application rather than spraying;" / tree: Paragraph 249 "... Glues and solvents 279 There are ... 282 Possible control measures include"

findings.problem: Numbered paragraphs 284 to 287 are merged into one unnumbered text block instead of separate paragraphs.
findings.evidence: tree: "284 Not all hazardous substances ... 285 Do not use high-pressure water ... 286 Leptospirosis ... 287 High standards"

findings.problem: Paragraph 288 is kept as an unnumbered text block, not as paragraph 288.
findings.evidence: tree: type "text" "288 Always provide good welfare facilities."

findings.problem: Numbered paragraphs 280 to 283 are merged into one text block with the bullets, and 284 to 287 into another, instead of separate paragraphs.
findings.evidence: tree: "eating and drinking food with contaminated hands. 280 The main effects are irritation"

findings.problem: The italic subheadings are made siblings of 'Inspecting equipment and anchors' instead of sitting under it.
findings.evidence: source: italic "Pre-use checks" under "Inspecting equipment and anchors" / tree: "Appendix 3 USE OF PERSONAL FALL-PROTECTION SYSTEMS > Pre-use checks"

findings.problem: Subheadings are read as body text at the end of the previous paragraph and are missing from the heading path of the paragraphs they introduce.
findings.evidence: source: "Pre-use checks" (heading) / tree: "unless this has been authorised by the manufacturer. Pre-use checks"

findings.problem: Same for the other subheadings, appended to paragraphs 19, 20, 21 and 22.
findings.evidence: tree: "tensioned safety lines. Detailed examination of equipment"; "12 months. Interim inspections"; "Inspection after a fall"; "Inspection of rescue equipment"
